Inside Elections just moved our race from "Tilt Democratic" to "Toss-up."
That means one thing: This race is going to be one of the closest House races in the entire country.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]

National Republicans have had their eye on this seat for years because they think it's one of their best opportunities to flip a district that will determine who controls Congress.
And now, one of the top election analysts in the country is confirming what we've known all along: This race will come down to the wire.
The truth is, I've never taken anything for granted. Not in 2022. Not in 2024. And certainly not now.
We won’t win automatically — not in a district this competitive. And to be honest, I wouldn’t want to. I work every day to earn this district’s votes because that’s exactly how democracy should work.
But now, we’re facing a flood of outside money that's about to pour into Southwest Washington because control of the House could come down to just a handful of seats.

Peter,

America turns 250 this July 4th.

I grew up all over Montana. Miles City. Helena. Dillon. Victor. Great Falls. July 4th looked a little different in each town but it always felt the same. We were proud. Not because someone told us to be. Just because we were.

My dad taught high school math. My mom taught elementary school. They were public servants their whole lives and they raised me to believe this country was worth showing up for.

_I still believe that._

I spent years as Montana's U.S. Attorney going after the cartels and criminals threatening families and communities. Now I am running for Senate because I think the next 250 years of this country are worth fighting for just as hard as the last.

Before July 4th, I want to ask you something. What does America mean to you?

name: Kurt Alme
subject: 250 years of American greatness
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alme for Senate
body:
This July 4th is unlike any other. I want to hear from you. |
---
Fellow Patriot,

America turns 250 this July 4th.

I grew up all over Montana. Miles City. Helena. Dillon. Victor. Great Falls. July 4th looked a little different in each town but it always felt the same. We were proud. Not because someone told us to be. Just because we were.

My dad taught high school math. My mom taught elementary school. They were public servants their whole lives and they raised me to believe this country was worth showing up for.

_I still believe that._

I spent years as Montana's U.S. Attorney going after the cartels and criminals threatening families and communities. Now I am running for Senate because I think the next 250 years of this country are worth fighting for just as hard as the last.

Before July 4th, I want to ask you something. What does America mean to you?

clean_body: This July 4th is unlike any other. I want to hear from you. | Fellow Patriot, America turns 250 this July 4th. I grew up all over Montana. Miles City. Helena. Dillon. Victor. Great Falls. July 4th looked a little different in each town but it always felt the same. We were proud. Not because someone told us to be. Just because we were. My dad taught high school math. I spent years as Montana's U.S. Attorney going after the cartels and criminals threatening families and communities. | I’m writing to ask for $3 to help me stop Republicans from putting a 2020 election denier in Georgia's governor's mansion -- where he could refuse to certify any Democratic win in the state.

No, that’s not a typo.

**Georgia’s Lieutenant Governor Burt Jones was one of the 16 fake electors who signed a false certificate claiming Donald Trump won Georgia in 2020. A certificate that was sent to Congress to try to block the certification of Joe Biden’s win.**

Now he wants to be Governor of Georgia, where he would be responsible for certifying our state's 2028 presidential election results.

I’m Keisha Lance Bottoms, the Democrat running to stop him.

We've won our primary election. I am officially the Democratic nominee for Governor of Georgia, and I need your help. [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/112293?t=6&akid=25088%2E878179%2E98wUgF) I know $3 might not seem like a lot – and that’s because it’s not.

But combined with thousands of other grassroots donors chipping in, your $3 has an enormous impact.

$3 helps us travel across the state, invest in critical resources, and fight back against the millions that Rick Jackson and Burt Jones are spending to lie about my record.

And $3 helps us fight back against Donald Trump’s attempts to steal this state by suppressing the vote.

## Trump Cancels Iran Strikes, Touts Deal
President Trump [canceled planned strikes](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFypDAQBNCvgUxbYha0KFBwCZkvvZCalQaYs5AoaWzM31-t7xMcd1VXv_7zNr8hR07rb9zJyZLnRGeNJEJllvKxHx6Tp1hRBP17rQd6-ppBg1HaqA7mgByvuW-DW4iA7i257jF2MIyjfbSbM36k3gQcjQ1oQdsebW_1HeCpn3oYWnavNm066LQeu-EGi316A8aPth-WwTe9psCSy-1v5iQbLfHKn1RuPu9tdJvIUZv7rwamBqbzPG9L_nopXnkD05EjC_vawPQNUhWvqjaq6j-NguKCSVUp_E5VYQhVHVkoCWNUgTCqymvitCrJClPKH8lTUHXLReLVFheOk2Pkah5Nr9cdOX5vkx8d-ungXwAAAP__i46OHg) against Iran on Thursday, saying treaty negotiations have been approved at "the highest level of Iranian leadership," with a signing to be announced shortly. The reversal came hours after Trump threatened to [seize Kharg Island](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1u8yAUxvGrgc0RHAPGA8O7eMu7drQIHGIa_CE4TZq7rxL1Djo_0l_6PR_n-exzydv1v1_RUdrnDR-tIBHWmerXegS_BSzNE_lwa-3wAb9nEGA6YToJc_S5PGfFo0uIgD1HJwcrQVs7DnxxPVo7qIsJw8WKGFEb0RtANHKUSanIs3vVhJEghbBSnyCNl2DABDsqnXRgSmDMtNfT5543WjCV537Hegr7yotbiI7G-n8MJgYTLbjkUl4bg-nYSw5PBlPEhFtDBpMeQfRWd29c96vrcvVb16jmGzYGE68uHo9cSm5mYEpcV5_fTU5_Ounu4CcAAP__YGR7IA), the hub of Iran's oil exports, and take control of the country's energy industry. Trump said a deal could be signed within days and that the terms had been approved by all parties, including Israel, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Egypt. Iran hasn't publicly confirmed an agreement. [See Trump's post](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0M2OozAQBOCngVsiuwH_HHxYacUte1ppj6ixm-Adg5HdSSZvP2JeYa5V0idV_btNN4wp7vc_uJHjJU87vWoiZioTl8d2eNw9pYrM6D9qPdDT5wQC1EWoi4QpYEzvqW-DW4iAupac1EbCYIzV7epmOwOgEaQNmGAgmBk9dkqrWWmruza6UxNKghTCyOEKi529AuWN7Ydl8E0vKETO5fo_x51XWtI7P6lcfd7a5FbmozbdrwbGBkYuD15r9hHT2Z9hLwph-p13TOHvOamB8ciVawOjlEp3oAawVksQUvVtceF4xZRiVbrpxX3D-E21_KN_ng6-AgAA__9hGnd3). The announcement came in the wake of an exchange of attacks by both nations, including an Iranian drone downing a U.S. Army helicopter near the Strait of Hormuz. The crew was rescued safely. [Watch the announcement of last night's canceled attack here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuwyAYBOCnwRsW_DbYHhi6eEvXjtZv-J3QYLCAxs3bV8krdD7pdN99XZYL-uDj9RN3MnVLS6SzBKqV8lLzz35YjJZCwVrR3ks50NLvAgI0F5pLWBz68Fz6xpmNCKhryMhhlKDGcRqam9G9Vh0JWNex6wZHq7IwuHXQdhrlIEXjzatNaAlSiFGqFrZptRq0HadebcqyXpDzNeX2O_lYb7SFZ3pQbm3am2ButR6FdR8MZgbzeZ5tXO1L8coZzDGdDOaHd5QYzG8TtxhC4Wnb-BEwRnK81OzvVHiK3GeMHHfv-JHTNVMpvKYTsyscuSMMHHQ_KdVrqTvVZOOO04fgix5YL647-vCeVv_158PAXwAAAP__rRGKjQ).
## White House Taps Jay Clayton as New Intel Chief
President Trump said Thursday he will [nominate Jay Clayton](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OqzAQhZ_GdCB7-IkpXNyGLrfdEg1mCM4ONoJJWN5-RV5hm9Mc6Ts639e9v2PgEB__cSEnU-ojHTuTCG29bK9l9Rg98Y4i6L_3fUVPPz1oaHLd5Ab6EQOffZWNbiICKjNy5mYN1Na2t2x27QAlDmBNjQYGbakqB6p9RQO2WNk6C-6i6caA0dqauoCpHXwDjbdtVU-1V5WmMUjaimcKUWaa-Exv2gqflozdLLLuqvynoFPQHcdR-Dj4q1TQXWgFnb7CGAXd51P-xDP3jKekmEeUkCJyHqIQc3hQ9JSvLxYqZlk429y4HoE57M1NVfqxYODPtvxJ2NvBbwAAAP__LE5_lA), Manhattan's top federal prosecutor and former chairman of the Securities and Exchange Commission, as the next director of national intelligence. ## Couple Sentenced to 40 Years for Pyramid Scheme
A Frisco couple was [sentenced to 40 years each in federal prison](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2S4yAUhE-DMlTwYEEbEGyizJtOqMLwZFHmrwRjWbefkq8wWQdfd3X312252RBDfvy3CU1_r2XJeLSIveO-PEp1Jb8w91ByxfY8K1pX3HMBBooyRTks3oZ4LnLw5s78Xz6g4XrioABADJtRdz2BUk4rUH-scEppOyED5EJIC2II5gpjigPnTEg2Sm6dnvTdazGtXHMiGfrQyz72DTu-bVvjWV64j66kIZqt99qI-EdgJjAfxzGu5S2vGRdAYL4kgfljpa5814i0Ye6YHXoqGT3R7o0KRlOIMZRMq80eU3C0nrtNwdPmNkw47MbX42Ka0kSyR7Ihflr03333MvATAAD__1CqhLE) for running a $30 million illegal pyramid scheme that defrauded more than 10,000 people nationwide during the COVID-19 pandemic. LaShonda Moore, 38, and Marlon Moore, 39, were convicted by a jury in January on conspiracy, wire fraud, and money laundering charges, the [Justice Department said](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDFuwyAUQE-DNyz4UOwMDF28pWtHi8CPTYMBAbHj21fNFXqA9570vq_z1fjg4_JlNtTtdU9zxKMGbA3LvKRsU9wxNp9ixvo4Mxqb7GMGBooyRTnMzvhwzrJz-sbchXeo-TByUAAgulVbvDC8IBp-AztKJSx-2BFAMikUF67z-k_GFAfOmZCsl9zYYRxubhDjnQ-cSIbOt1T6tmLDl6n3cKYdS2_T1gW9tpYrEZ8EJgLTcRz9z7M2b7Ff0k5gStkQmHIhML1patMzB6QVY8No0dHyjNHHhfoQcDGB5rOYzTta7YobdkW7fPgQfFUDkWzZjA_vdvvfsV3DbwAAAP__R6mCZw). Their "Blessings in No Time" program operated from June 2020 to June 2021.
